source_file: Miracle Industries — Tubing Hanger Spools and Couplings (web product page)
description: Tubing Hanger Spool (THS) + Tubing Hanger Coupling (THC) catalogue. The spool sits between the casing head and the Christmas tree; it carries the tubing hanger that suspends the production tubing string. Flanges are sized per API 6A pressure class. The coupling variant uses a union nut so the back-pressure valve can be installed without rotating the tree.

rows.notes: 2M class. Bottom-prep counterbore lands a 4½" tubing string.
Mixed-class 3M bottom / 5M top; common for older wellheads being upgraded above the casing flange.
5M class. Most common API 6A 5K rating for moderate-pressure completions.
5M class, larger bore for 3½" or larger tubing.
Large-bore 5M variant; takes 4½" tubing and a full-opening 4-1/16" master valve.
15M class. Smaller bore on the top flange — reflects API 6A pressure-vs-bore derating at 15K.
Union-nut coupling for 2-3/8" API external-upset tubing. Lets the BPV be screwed in without spinning the tree.
Union-nut coupling for 2-7/8" API EUE tubing.
Union-nut coupling for 3-1/2" API EUE tubing.
Union-nut coupling for 4-1/2" API EUE tubing.

fields.kind: 'spool' (THS — flanged spool between casing head and tree) or 'coupling' (THC — union-nut coupling for BPV installation)
fields.model: Synthetic part number used as primary key; encodes flange sizes + pressure class
fields.bottom_flange_od_in: Lower flange OD (mates to casing head). Inches.
fields.bottom_flange_pressure_psi: API 6A pressure rating of the bottom flange (2K, 3K, 5K, 10K, 15M).
fields.top_flange_od_in: Upper flange OD (mates to the Christmas tree). Inches.
fields.top_flange_pressure_psi: API 6A pressure rating of the top flange.
fields.bore_in: Vertical bore through the spool. Tubing string passes through this. Inches.
fields.bottom_prep_in: Counterbore at the lower face that lands the tubing hanger.  Inches.
fields.coupling_od_in: OD of the union nut on the coupling variant. Inches.
fields.tubing_size_in: Nominal OD of the tubing this coupling threads onto. Inches.
fields.thread: Tubing thread form (API EUE = external upset end).
